title: Resource economics experiment grid: prefetching, adaptive batching, and quantization playbook
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Initiative to create a repeatable experiment grid and rollout playbook that balances token-level cost savings against latency and quality regressions. Focus areas: request prefetch/pipeline priming, adaptive batching policies (latency-aware vs cost-aware), and quantization profiles (int8/int4 mixed). Goal is to formalize hypotheses, measurement methodology, and safe rollout gates so Platform and Runtime teams can deliver predictable unit-economics improvements without degrading SLOs or quality.
success_metrics: Reduce median token cost for chat workloads by 12% within pilot customers
<=5% increase in 95th-pctl latency for P0 routes during controlled rollouts
Quality regression alert rate < 0.5% (as measured by eval prompt set) across pilot models
Establish experiment-oriented dashboards and runbook with <24h detection-to-mitigation time
milestones: 2026-03-05: Baseline telemetry collected for target routes and models
2026-03-19: First experiment matrix (6 variants) started on staging
2026-04-09: Analyze staging results, pick 2 safe variants for canary
2026-04-23: Canary rollout to 5% traffic with rollback hooks
2026-06-01: Post-mortem and formalize playbook for org-wide adoption
experiment_grid: Variant 1 - Baseline: no prefetch, static batch=1, FP16
Variant 2 - Prefetch-Lite: prefetch last-turn KV only, adaptive batching (latency-first), FP16
Variant 3 - Prefetch-Aggressive: prefix prefetch + pipelined KV fetch, batch=32, int8 quant
Variant 4 - Adaptive-Batch-Cost: cost-aware batching target 80% GPU util, batch cap 128, int8
Variant 5 - Mixed-Quant: int4 for MLP layers + int8 attention, prefetch-lag compensator, batch adaptive
Variant 6 - Cache-Only: heavy prefix KV cache with TTL tuning, no quant, batch adaptive
measurement_plan: Collect per-token cost and GPU utilization, sampled at 1s granularity
Measure latency p50/p90/p95 and tail CPU/GPU stalls
Run evaluation prompt set for functional/regression checks per model variant
Track failure modes: timeouts, OOMs, hallucination-rate proxy metrics
Annotate customer-facing routes vs background routes to weight business impact
rollout_strategy: Start experiments in isolated staging with synthetic and anonymized traffic. Promote to internal canary (prod traffic but internal org only) for two weeks. If metrics pass gates (cost reduction, latency SLOs, quality checks), run 5% customer canary with real traffic for one week. Use automated rollback triggers based on latency/quality thresholds and manual kill switch for abnormal error spikes.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Quantization causes subtle quality regressions - Mitigation: pair eval prompt set + human spot checks; require quality alert threshold before rollback
Risk: Prefetch increases upstream resource usage and bursts - Mitigation: rate limit prefetch threads and add backpressure to router
Risk: Adaptive batching increases latency tail for interactive routes - Mitigation: route-level policy to exclude latency-sensitive customers and add dynamic batch caps
Risk: Metrics noise from multi-tenant variation - Mitigation: stratify experiments by tenant size and per-route cohorts
